guild.registered: I signed with the Adventurers Guild in Hearthmere. Rank F: the board's jobs are mine.
rank.e: I beat Rhea in the yard. Rank E.
rank.d: Rhea fought me at full strength this time, and I still won. Rank D.
archive.secret: A warm glyph in a cracked wall of the Flooded Stacks opened a hidden vault in the Sunken Archive. Its strongbox wants an Auren key.
archive.keeper: I brought down the Keeper in the deepest hall of the Sunken Archive. Its gate opened on a way back up to Silver Falls.
